standard_solution_code:
for _ in range(int(input())):
	(n, mod, q) = map(int, input().split())
	ls = [0] * n
	ls[1] = n
	for i in range(2, n):
		ls[1] = ls[1] * i % mod
	n += 1
	if n % 2:
		(num, den, cur) = (n // 2 + 1, n // 2, n // 2 + 1)
	else:
		(num, den, cur) = (n // 2, n // 2, 1)
	n -= 1
	ls[den] = cur
	num += 1
	den -= 1
	while den > 1:
		cur = cur * (den + 1) % mod
		cur = cur * num % mod
		ls[den] = cur
		num += 1
		den -= 1
	for i in range(2, n // 2 + 1):
		ls[i] = ls[i] * ls[i - 1] % mod
	for __ in range(q):
		x = int(input())
		if x > n / 2:
			x = n - x
		print(ls[x])
